svg.title: The evidence ladder
svg.desc: Five individually witnessed claims about one candidate revision. Human acceptance and physical-device observation remain independent. System model: The evidence ladder. 01 / Observed Source examined. 02 / Implemented Change exists. 03 / Merged Revision integrated. 04 / Qualified Named checks pass. 05 / Verified Live production observed. Human acceptance Does it meet the brief?. Physical proof Does it work on the real device?. One candidate revision. Five ordered claims, each independently observed. Human acceptance and physical proof are separate observations; no earlier claim establishes a later one.
